entries.title: Astroneer
entries.definitive_edition: Astroneer Ultimate Edition route on Windows PC with Glitchwalkers and Megatech

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Ultimate Edition route with Glitchwalkers and Megatech DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC version has the strongest capture/modulation route and the full DLC path through Glitchwalkers and Megatech. Console releases, including PS5 and Switch, are valid but do not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Astroneer on Steam or Microsoft Store for Windows PC and add Glitchwalkers plus Megatech, or buy an Ultimate/Glitchwalkers/Megatech bundle where available.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Glitchwalkers and Megatech DLC available.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete DLC route and best capture/input platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox One release with Glitchwalkers/Megatech bundle route.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox Series route through Xbox family support with 4K Ultra HD capability documented on the current store bundle.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but PC remains the preferred capture/input platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS4 console release with Glitchwalkers and Megatech DLC route.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Nintendo Switch handheld/TV release with Glitchwalkers and Megatech DLC route.
all_releases.reason: skip: portable route, but PC remains the preferred capture/input platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 release alongside Megatech, with 60 fps and 4K support.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong current-generation console route, but PC remains the preferred capture/input platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Glitchwalkers and Megatech are available across the main current platform routes; PC remains the best complete capture/input route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Glitchwalkers and Megatech are paid expansions, not separate game entries. The PS5 release is a native platform release/upgrade route rather than a remaster.
